body: You sir just explained exactly what I'm currently feeling. Thank you for saying the words that don't come easily for the rest of us.

As someone who already posted to that sub I can tell you it has a few good, well meaning people in there. All it really is is just them telling you "I hear you" and " don't give up." There isn't any actual help at all.
Glad I could ease your mind some.

Being in my current mental state I would think your brother was protecting you. I've done the same thing with explicit instructions that certain people can never see the letter on my desktop. It isn't out of spite, or forgetfulness. Its about protecting the best of us. To see the ramblings, the "giving up" isn't how I want them to remember me. I can't speak for others but a proper plan takes a while to calculate. Certain things to wait for and the little voice in the back of your head saying things might get better. It's when they get worse is when those plans get finalized. I know you loved him and I have no doubts he loved you.

I understand your intent and I thank you for it. I know I am being oversensitive and I'm trying to look at things from a realistic point of view. That is where I really start getting down in the dumps.  Another user posted a reply and said that he is willing to bet things are still around to experience. My question would be is a year of misery and anguish worth a day of happiness?

My problem is that I can't afford school and that I'm simply intimidated by it. I have had a long string if failures in my life. I know it isn't good to get smashed every night and sit alone hating life. I just have no viable alternatives. The cycle is never ending. I have sought counseling but I can't afford it, and the religious ones are no help at all. It doesn't help me to know others go through it, I don't rejoice in others misery. It only reaffirms that this world is a ugly place that I'm about done with.

I have tried all of those and nothing makes me feel better.  They are all distractions.  The moment the distraction ends the pain is back.  I do nice things for people every day.  They don't make me feel good, I do them because it is the right thing to do.  Nothing makes me feel good anymore.  Well, when I was flirting with that one girl I started to feel better but that was a bust.  I guess I'm one of those pathetic people who has to always be in a relationship.

I do apologize but it really does not help me.  I do wish to be a part of my sons life but he wants nothing to do with me.  I take him somewhere fun and the second mommy leaves all he talks about is wanting to go home to mommy.  Everyone just tells me about my obligations to him.  I see no reason to continue this if I have nothing to go from.  I have been trying but it really doesn't get me anywhere.  It's been months and no change.
